rationale: Direct check closing the last registered obligation, claim-config-rollback-consistency, using its accepted binding bind-append-entries-truncate (Raft.appendEntries, raft.go 1440-1584). This is deliberate execution corroborating a protection that source reading already explained: the reset latest := committed runs only when entry.Index <= latestIndex and, for a legal leader, entry.Index is always above the follower's committed configuration index, so the reset target is inside the retained prefix. The harness builds the pre-state through the library's own startup configuration scan, drives one legal conflicting AppendEntries at the uncommitted configuration index, and measures whether the follower's latest configuration index equals the committed one it kept. I compiled and ran the harness locally in the scratch copy first; it builds and the truncation leaves latest index 1, committed index 1, one published server and a command entry at the truncated index 3.
